title: Governed tags system table is in Beta
body:
The `system.tags.governed_tags` system table is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). This table contains a record for each governed tag key in your account, including customer-created and system-generated tags. Use it to programmatically determine which tags in your account are governed.

See [Governed tags system table reference](/aws/en/admin/system-tables/governed-tags).
